label:
Lactotripeptide milk
(Ameal S, Evolus)
note: Two routes exist: this one ferments skimmed milk; the other digests casein with enzymes (patent US7785824). Trial evidence is mixed: a Cochrane review (Usinger 2012) found no confirmed ACE-inhibiting effect in people.

about.text: Milk soured with Lactobacillus helveticus, whose enzymes cut the casein so that two tiny peptides, Val-Pro-Pro (VPP) and Ile-Pro-Pro (IPP), come free. Both inhibit angiotensin-converting enzyme in the test tube, and the milk is sold in Japan and Finland to people with mild high blood pressure.

facts.v: Hata 1996 (Am J Clin Nutr 64:767-771) and Seppo 2003 found lower systolic pressure; Cochrane (Usinger 2012) found no conclusive benefit
